title: Show your strange little thing.
scene: OBJECT STILL LIFE, NO living character: an adorable homemade MOLE-SHAPED ROBOT on a wooden inventor's workbench. Squat rounded brass and cream tin body, pointed conical pink metal snout, two tiny blue light-up eyes, broad little shovel paws, rivets and one stubby antenna. A small red push button on its back. A screwdriver and simple mole robot sketch on paper nearby. Warm honey afternoon workshop. Robot dominates 75% of image, clear cute mole silhouette.
motion: The tiny mole-shaped robot's blue eyes blink, pink metal nose twitches once, one shovel paw gives a tiny wave and returns. Body stays planted, no walking. Background, tools and paper stay fixed.
